desc: The Global Ordnance Monolith is the evolution of a bufferless rifle platform, featuring an innovative one-piece barrel, machined from a single piece of 41v50 ordnance grade steel using a proprietary process, to provide superior accuracy, reliability, and suppressor concentricity. This "monolith barrel" combines the bore, barrel extension, gas block, and Dead Air KeyMo muzzle brake into a single, seamless part that, when paired with a new heavy duty bolt design, represent a significant leap forward in a 70 year old design. The Monolith includes an integrated folding adjustable stock, ambidextrous controls, and folding forward charging handle. This revolutionary rifle platform is compact, lightweight, feature-rich, and will redefine your expectations of what a firearm can be.
